verdicts.reason: A packs everything into the top 60%, leaving roughly 300px of empty orange at the bottom. Its bottle cap almost touches the top edge, and the faint decorative circle overlaps the bottle's circle clumsily. B centres the stack vertically and keeps the decorative circle apart in the corner, so it is better balanced. Both share the same flaws: the headline is left-aligned while the NEW pill and Try It button are right-aligned, so there is no common axis, and the NEW badge floats away from the product it labels.
